messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: billing-metering alert (token_count drift) — EU ingestion lag + inflated token counts. Severity: P2. Link: https://rwd/ops/alerts/1804447777
caroline: I'm on it, pulling latest reconciler metrics
samir: I see a 27% delta between kafka-consumer and aggregator around 2026-03-18T02:10Z
ashley: are customers getting overage flags? any immediate billing emails?
billing-service: flagged 12 customers with overage emails between 02:12-02:20Z, paused auto-alerts
caroline: ok pausing outbound notifications, setting flag:notify=false
miguel: repro log snippets:
```
2026-03-18T02:09:53Z consumer: read 1,234,567 tokens partition=eu-1
2026-03-18T02:09:54Z aggregator: emit 1,548,912 tokens window=02:09-02:10
```
samir: looks like duplicate replay from consumer retry paths; producer ack delay + double-emit on reconnect
caroline: can someone check kafka offsets? `kafka-consumer groups --describe --group metering-eu`
ashley: offsets show two active consumers on same group id (consumer-1, consumer-replay) — suspect orchestrator restart
oncall-pager: assigning to @caroline for initial mitigation
caroline: mitigation plan: 1) pause consumer replay; 2) backfill de-dupe job; 3) silence notifications
samir: pausing replay now -> `kubectl scale deployment replay-consumer --replicas=0 -n metering` : done 02:15Z
billing-service: notifications paused ✋ 02:16Z
miguel: starting de-dupe job (id: dedupe-1804) — will run approx 12m
caroline: running quick live-recon to compute corrected token deltas
samir: recon results: total delta +312,345 tokens in window -> after dedupe expected -312,345
ashley: customers already billed? finance says daily invoices generated at 03:00Z for some accounts
caroline: immediate action: create temporary credit for affected accounts and rollback overage emails queued
billing-service: queued emails cancelled 02:20Z
miguel: dedupe job finished 02:27Z, results:
```
processed 1400 partitions
duplicates removed: 310,112 tokens
final delta within tolerance: 1.7%
```
samir: aggregator counters now match consumer at 02:28Z
caroline: re-enable notifications after we confirm no false positives. waiting 5m
ashley: can ops create a postmortem ticket? tag: billing-metering-eu-1804
caroline: noted, will open with runbook items + RCA
oncall-pager: handoff to SRE morning shift @miguel — watchlist for 24h
billing-service: customers credited, emails sent to affected accounts with explanation 02:40Z
samir: root cause: consumer replay started by orchestrator bug (duplicate pod startup) which resulted in out-of-order ack handling -> double-emit. fix: add idempotency key and consumer group hardening
caroline: follow-ups: 1) add kafka consumer guardrails (circuit on restart) 2) implement idempotency token at aggregator 3) playbook update
ashley: nice work. closing incident thread when postmortem writeup ready
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: P2 -> mitigated. duration 0:30:22
